nodes.summary: For a natural number $m$, write $S_m(231, 3124)$ for the set of permutations of $\{0, 1, \dots, m-1\}$ that avoid both patterns $231$ and $3124$, that is, contain neither of them. Let $n \ge 1$ and let $j$ be a position with $j + 1 < n$. Then the number of permutations $\sigma \in S_n(231, 3124)$ with $\sigma(j) = 0$ equals $(j + 1) \cdot |S_{n-j-1}(231, 3124)|$.
nodes.title: Position of the smallest entry in $(231, 3124)$-avoiding permutations

nodes.summary: For every $n \ge 1$, the number of permutations of $\{0, 1, \dots, n-1\}$ that avoid both patterns $231$ and $3124$, that is, contain neither of them, is the Fibonacci number $F_{2n-1}$, where $F_0 = 0$ and $F_1 = 1$.
nodes.title: $(231, 3124)$-avoiding permutations are counted by odd-indexed Fibonacci numbers

nodes.summary: Let $n \ge 2$. Among the permutations $\sigma$ of $\{0, 1, \dots, n-1\}$ that avoid both patterns $321$ and $3412$, that is, contain neither of them, the number with $\sigma(0) = 0$ and the number with $\sigma(1) = 0$ are both equal to the Fibonacci number $F_{2n-3}$, where $F_0 = 0$ and $F_1 = 1$.
nodes.title: Smallest entry in the first two positions of $(321, 3412)$-avoiding permutations

nodes.summary: For every $n \ge 1$, the number of permutations of $\{0, 1, \dots, n-1\}$ that avoid both patterns $321$ and $3412$, that is, contain neither of them, is the Fibonacci number $F_{2n-1}$, where $F_0 = 0$ and $F_1 = 1$.
nodes.title: $(321, 3412)$-avoiding permutations are counted by odd-indexed Fibonacci numbers

Let $n \ge 1$ and let $j$ be a position with $j + 1 < n$. Then the number of permutations $\sigma \in S_n(321, 4123)$ with $\sigma(j) = 0$ equals $(j + 1) \cdot |S_{n-j-1}(321, 4123)|$.
nodes.title: Position of the smallest entry in $(321, 4123)$-avoiding permutations

nodes.summary: For every $n \ge 1$, the number of permutations of $\{0, 1, \dots, n-1\}$ that avoid both patterns $321$ and $4123$, that is, contain neither of them, is the Fibonacci number $F_{2n-1}$, where $F_0 = 0$ and $F_1 = 1$.
nodes.title: $(321, 4123)$-avoiding permutations are counted by odd-indexed Fibonacci numbers

nodes.summary: Let $\sigma$ be a permutation of $\{0, 1, \dots, n-1\}$ and let $\pi$ be a map from $\{0, 1, \dots, k-1\}$ to itself. Then $\sigma$ contains the pattern $\pi$ if there are positions $e_0 < e_1 < \dots < e_{k-1}$ in $\{0, 1, \dots, n-1\}$ such that for all $i, j < k$, $\sigma(e_i) < \sigma(e_j)$ holds exactly when $\pi(i) < \pi(j)$.
nodes.title: Classical pattern containment in a permutation

nodes.summary: The pattern $231$ written with values $0, 1, 2$: the map from $\{0, 1, 2\}$ to itself sending $0 \mapsto 1$, $1 \mapsto 2$ and $2 \mapsto 0$.
nodes.title: The pattern $231$

nodes.summary: The pattern $3124$ written with values $0, 1, 2, 3$: the map from $\{0, 1, 2, 3\}$ to itself sending $0 \mapsto 2$, $1 \mapsto 0$, $2 \mapsto 1$ and $3 \mapsto 3$.
nodes.title: The pattern $3124$

nodes.summary: The pattern $321$ written with values $0, 1, 2$: the map from $\{0, 1, 2\}$ to itself sending $0 \mapsto 2$, $1 \mapsto 1$ and $2 \mapsto 0$.
nodes.title: The pattern $321$

nodes.summary: The pattern $3412$ with its values shifted down by one: the map $\{0, 1, 2, 3\} \to \{0, 1, 2, 3\}$ sending $0, 1, 2, 3$ to $2, 3, 0, 1$ respectively.
nodes.title: The permutation pattern $3412$

nodes.summary: The pattern $4123$ with its values shifted down by one: the map $\{0, 1, 2, 3\} \to \{0, 1, 2, 3\}$ sending $0, 1, 2, 3$ to $3, 0, 1, 2$ respectively.
nodes.title: The permutation pattern $4123$

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
